registryAssessment: Dazhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau’s official 2024 departmental accounts identify the Dazhou Real Estate Registration Center as a subordinate unit. A municipal land-supply procedure also assigns the city cadastral affairs center boundary/area surveys and the land survey/planning team plot boundary maps. These confirm local registration and cadastral functions, not a public vector service or point coverage.
